name: The Moon Window
body:
On the third floor landing, just before the stairs to the rooftop, a single circular window frames the moon perfectly on clear nights.

NOBODY PLANNED IT. The architects did not design it. IT APPEARED DURING CONSTRUCTION, right around the time Lumina danced on the unfinished third floor under open sky and Abbi watched from the stairwell with tears she will never admit to.

THE GIRLS CALL IT LUMINA'S WINDOW. She does not know this.
